task_title: A symlinked DIRECTORY resolving outside the corpus root is refused by both verbs and its content never leaks (AUG-169)
task_criteria: PASS: pytest tests/test_xml_specs.py -q -k symlinked_directory prints 1 passed — the new directory pin is collected and green. PROOF: pytest tests/test_xml_specs.py -q -k symlinked_directory, summary `1 passed, 58 deselected`. FAILIF: 0 passed, a collection error, or a selected count other than 59.

PASS: pytest tests/test_xml_specs.py -q -k symlink prints at least 3 passed — the two shipped file-level pins plus the new directory pin. PROOF: pytest tests/test_xml_specs.py -q -k symlink, summary `3 passed, 56 deselected`. FAILIF: fewer than 3 passed or a collection error.

PASS: the gate pytest arm still names tests/test_xml_specs.py at least twice, so the new pin is enforced rather than merely written. PROOF: grep -c tests/test_xml_specs.py tests/gate.sh prints 2. FAILIF: grep prints 0 or 1.

PASS: pytest tests/test_xml_specs.py::test_a_symlinked_directory_resolving_outside_the_root_is_refused -q prints 1 passed — that test asserts both verbs refuse rc 2 with symlink-outside-root, names the link and its target, counts the skipped document, and puts the sentinel body in neither stream nor the refusal detail. PROOF: pytest tests/test_xml_specs.py::test_a_symlinked_directory_resolving_outside_the_root_is_refused -q prints `1 passed`. FAILIF: any failure, or the node is not collected.

PASS: python3 auger.py spec validate specs --repo-root . prints `spec: 3 document(s), 12 block(s), 7 reference(s) ok` at rc 0 and discovery follows directory symlinks (grep -c followlinks auger.py prints 2), so the shipped corpus is untouched and the walk no longer relies on plain rglob. PROOF: python3 auger.py spec validate specs --repo-root . rc 0 with that exact summary, plus grep -c followlinks auger.py -> 2. FAILIF: non-zero rc, a different document/block/reference count, or a followlinks count below 1.

Body at tests/test_xml_specs.py:1414-1474 asserts, for both `validate` and `check`: rc==2, empty stdout, `spec error (symlink-outside-root)` in err, `"sub"` (link) in err, `str(outside)` (target) in err, sentinel absent from out and err; then `load_spec_corpus` raises SpecError code `symlink-outside-root` with sentinel absent from detail; then `list --id SL-REAL-1` rc 0 with `skipped 1 unreadable document(s)`; then `assemble --id SL-DIR-SECRET-1` -> `matched: 0`.

items.criterion: PASS: python3 auger.py spec validate specs --repo-root . prints `spec: 3 document(s), 12 block(s), 7 reference(s) ok` at rc 0 and discovery follows directory symlinks (grep -c followlinks auger.py prints 2), so the shipped corpus is untouched and the walk no longer relies on plain rglob. PROOF: python3 auger.py spec validate specs --repo-root . rc 0 with that exact summary, plus grep -c followlinks auger.py -> 2. FAILIF: non-zero rc, a different document/block/reference count, or a followlinks count below 1.
items.detail: Ran `python3 auger.py spec validate specs --repo-root .` -> `spec: 3 document(s), 12 block(s), 7 reference(s) ok`, `rc=0`. `grep -c followlinks auger.py` -> `2`: the comment at auger.py:8007 and the real walk `for dirpath, dirnames, filenames in os.walk(root, followlinks=True):` at auger.py:8009; no `rglob` remains in `_spec_discover_documents` (auger.py:7982-8060).

items.criterion: Derived: both verbs actually refuse an out-of-root symlinked DIRECTORY at the CLI (rc 2, typed code, link and target named, no content leak) — not just inside the test harness.
items.detail: Manual probe outside pytest: corpus with `sub -> /tmp/aug169probe/outside` holding a sentinel document. `python3 auger.py spec validate /tmp/aug169probe/corpus` -> `spec error (symlink-outside-root): sub: the symlinked directory resolves to /tmp/aug169probe/outside, outside the corpus root /tmp/aug169probe/corpus (only local documents inside the root are read)`, rc=2; `spec check` -> identical message, rc=2; `spec list --id SL-REAL-1` -> rc=0 with `spec: skipped 1 unreadable document(s)` and the typed code in the note. The sentinel string never appeared in any stream. Code path: auger.py:8021-8041 (directory symlink resolved before descent, refusal appended, `continue  # never descend, never read beneath it`), consumed by auger.py:8791 (load_spec_corpus) and auger.py:8867 (_xml_spec_documents).

items.criterion: Derived: the followlinks walk cannot loop — a symlinked directory pointing back up the tree terminates instead of hanging.
items.detail: Probe: corpus/a/real.xml plus `corpus/a/loop -> corpus` (self-cycle) and `corpus/alias -> corpus/a`. `timeout 60 python3 auger.py spec validate /tmp/aug169cyc/corpus` returned immediately with rc=2 `spec error (duplicate-id): SL-REAL-1 declared in a/real.xml and alias/real.xml` — no hang, no unbounded walk. Guard is the resolved-path set at auger.py:8008/8011-8013 and the `if resolved_dir in visited_dirs: continue` check at auger.py:8037-8038.

items.criterion: Derived: the other spec verbs that share _spec_discover_documents keep their behaviour (no regression from the rglob -> os.walk swap).
items.detail: `python3 -m pytest tests/test_xml_specs.py tests/test_spec_validators_agree.py tests/test_spec_repository_root.py tests/test_spec_corpus_view.py -q` -> `105 passed in 10.26s` (exit 0); `python3 -m pytest tests/test_spec_validate_obligations.py tests/test_spec_obligation_gate.py tests/test_spec_decision_ref.py tests/test_spec_rollback.py tests/test_spec_render.py tests/test_spec_assembly_report.py tests/test_spec_alignment_check.py tests/test_spec_context.py -q` -> `94 passed in 8.81s` (exit 0).
